title.en: Apply the two rules for solving

say.en: 2 is less than 3. Multiply both by minus 1 and you get minus 2 and minus 3, and now minus 2 is the bigger one. The sign must flip. In this lesson: Apply the two rules for solving.
Know when the sign reverses.

body.en: Rule 1: the same number may be added to (or subtracted from) both sides; the sign does not change. Rule 2: both sides may be multiplied or divided by the same positive number; the sign does not change. If the number is negative, the sign is reversed: $<$ becomes $>$ and $\le$ becomes $\ge$.
body.kn: ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕಳೆದರೆ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಧನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೂ ಬದಲಾಗದು; ಋಣ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ ಚಿಹ್ನೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Solve 3x − 7 > 5x − 1.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Solve 3x minus 7 is greater than 5x minus 1.
Subtract 5x and add 7: 3x minus 5x is greater than minus 1 plus 7, so minus 2x is greater than 6.
Divide by minus 2 and reverse: x is less than minus 3.
So the answer is x is less than minus 3, that is (- infinity, minus 3).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Solve 4x + 3 < 5x + 7 for real x.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Solve 4x plus 3 is less than 5x plus 7 for real x.
Subtract 4x and 7 from both sides: 3 minus 7 is less than 5x minus 4x.
So minus 4 is less than x.
So the answer is x is greater than minus 4, that is (minus 4, infinity).

body.en: Collect the x terms on the side where their coefficient stays positive. Then you never divide by a negative number and never forget to flip the sign.
